title: Brush Test
alt: Seven rows of brush strokes in different colors across three vertical stripes. Below them are an area of orange and purple strokes and a gradient from blue to cream.
summary: A sheet that shows each brush of the painting program in {strokes} brush strokes, with a playback of each stroke.
text: This sheet shows each brush of the program. From top to bottom, the rows are the round, soft, flat, bristle, dry, wash and blend brushes.
The two areas at the bottom show many strokes together. The strokes in the left area follow a curved direction. The right area has blended colors. The sheet has {strokes} brush strokes.
